topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't rightly fathom it, can’t wrap my head 'round the idea. That scamp who climbed every tree with me, who helped me plant the first seeds in my garden when our arms could barely stretch wide enough to cover the rows—that same lad who claimed we'd be brothers of the soil till our last days, now he's telling me he's never known me? The life of me, I can’t understand. It’s like the earth shifting beneath my feet, the sun refusing to rise. I sowed his name into the earth, year after year, and now it's as if the very memory's been plucked clean out by some cruel hand. What’s a man to do when the past is nothing but dust in the wind?
